description: One stateless tutoring request about one lesson.

focus_block_key.description: Block the learner is looking at, if any.
focus_block_key.title: Focus Block Key

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated id of this request. A repeat is never charged twice.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

lesson_revision_id.description: The immutable revision the learner is reading. When given, Jude answers only from exactly that revision.
lesson_revision_id.title: Lesson Revision Id

locale.description: Language of the lesson content being read.
locale.title: Locale

message.description: The student's own words. Never stored, never logged.
message.title: Message

question_key.description: Practice question this request is about, if any.
question_key.title: Question Key

response_locale.description: Language Jude answers in. Defaults to `locale`.
response_locale.title: Response Locale

support_level.description: How much help was already given for the same difficulty (1 = first ask). Kept by the client: the server stores no conversation.
support_level.title: Support Level

title: Jude request (tutor contract v1)
